title: OneLake and Delta tables: files and a log
objectives: Say how OneLake, workspaces, lakehouses and shortcuts fit together
Read a Delta table's log: which files make up each version
Explain what OPTIMIZE and VACUUM change, and why VACUUM keeps 7 days

exercises.prompt: List the files that make up version 2 of the table: path and num_records, by path.
hints: A file belongs to version 2 if it was added at version 2 or before, and not removed at version 2 or before.
Start from the add rows with version <= 2, then leave out every path that has a remove row with version <= 2 (NOT EXISTS).

exercises.prompt: Show how many rows the table had at each version: version and row_count, oldest first.
hints: Take every version once (SELECT DISTINCT version FROM delta_log) and, for each, the files that were live then.
Join each version v to the add rows with version <= v, leave out paths removed at or before v, and sum num_records.
